card.name: "Most common" and approximate percentages
card.fires_on: The word "common" right after "the most", as in "the most common adverse reaction". Also the blank space token right before a percentage or count after "about" or "approximately" or a colon.

card.writes: It suppresses the word "common" and its variants, so the model avoids repeating it right after it has appeared.
card.plain: It marks the spot after "the most" where "common" is expected, and the gap before an approximate percentage.
